title: autosar-ecu-sim config schema v2
description: Every field is optional and falls back to its default. Cross-field rule enforced at start-up: hysteresis.<channel> < thresholds.<channel>.

rampSteps.description: 0 = monotonic ramp; N = triangle wave rising N samples then falling N samples

tempNoise.description: Alternating +/- offset added to each temperature sample

pressureNoise.description: Alternating +/- offset added to each pressure sample

temperature.description: degC; alarm raised when value >= threshold

pressure.description: bar; alarm raised when value >= threshold

temperature.description: degC; alarm cleared when value < threshold - hysteresis

pressure.description: bar; alarm cleared when value < threshold - hysteresis

periodMs.description: Maximum wait for a sample before re-checking lifecycle state

capacity.description: Ring-buffer size; oldest event dropped on overflow
